description: Plans one commit per changed file, in dependency order, with a `[numero] - [tipo] - [descrição]` subject. Excludes likely secrets. Default is plan. Pass approved:true and the same commits list to create the commits. Does not open a pull request. If includes_pr is true, next_tool is runrunit_check_pr.

approved.description: Default false. When false or omitted, returns a plan and does not change git. Set true only after the user approves that plan.

commits.description: Approved commits (path + message). When present, this list is used as-is and is not reordered. Required shape of the plan you are approving.

description.description: Default description when a file does not set its own.

files.description: Optional explicit files. Secrets in this list are dropped from the plan.

includes_pr.description: When true, next_tool is runrunit_check_pr. This tool still does not open a PR.

project_root.description: Absolute path of the git repository. Required for tools that read or write that repo.

task_id.description: Task number, or task_[número]. Used in branch names and commit subjects.

type.description: Default commit type when a file does not set its own.

name: runrunit_commit_per_file
